challenged_object: Claim C03: theorem-level novelty is established against a dated baseline.
admissible_variation: A referee holds that the residue/factorization theorem family is an elementary restatement of the standard fact that a function factors uniquely through its image iff it is constant on the fibres of the observation.
activation_condition: Activated because the encoded core theorems (image-relative factorization, evaluator obstruction, refinement monotonicity, splitting) are elementary and standard in universal algebra / category-theoretic terms.
defeat_condition: Defeated only by exhibiting a non-elementary, independently novel formal result at theorem-to-theorem granularity against the baseline.
resolution_summary: Unresolved: no successor version supplying a stronger novelty warrant is available in this instance; the objection stands and lowers the recommendation.

challenged_object: Claim C04: significance is connected to a new formal closure and separation capability.
admissible_variation: A referee holds that the claimed capability rests on the central closure/completeness theorems, which are prose-only, so the significance is not carried by a verified result.
activation_condition: Activated because the central "sound bounded closure" and "relative completeness" theorems are not encoded/verified (TheoremLeanCorrespondence maps them to none).
defeat_condition: Defeated by a verified central theorem plus a demonstrated capability not reducible to the elementary core.
resolution_summary: Unresolved: significance beyond the elementary core is not established in this instance.

challenged_object: Claim A09/C02: the central theorem is transmitted with exact, status-labeled Lean correspondence.
admissible_variation: A referee holds that the paper is centered on the sound bounded-closure theorem, yet that theorem and relative completeness and the carrier-root theorem are explicitly not encoded in Lean.
activation_condition: Activated by TheoremLeanCorrespondence_v23.csv rows mapping the central results to "none / not encoded".
defeat_condition: Defeated by encoding and machine-checking the central theorems, or by restating the contribution so the verified elementary core is the sole headline claim.
resolution_summary: Unresolved: the central results remain prose-only; the formal-correctness carrier does not close for the headline claim.

challenged_object: Claim A07: Lean builds successfully under the recorded toolchain (mandatory mechanical condition).
admissible_variation: A referee/editor requires the successful machine build certificate; it is absent.
activation_condition: Activated because the machine Lean build was not obtained: the Mathlib toolchain registry and compiled-cache hosts are denied by the session egress policy and a from-source Mathlib build did not complete.
defeat_condition: Defeated by producing a successful lake build with exit code 0 bound to the exact source hash (e.g. in an environment permitting the Lean/Mathlib hosts).
resolution_summary: Unresolved in this environment: the mandatory successful-build certificate cannot be issued here. This is an environmental execution gap, not a proof of a source defect.

challenged_object: Claim C14: the integrated recommendation is accept-level with no active major-revision condition.
admissible_variation: A referee integrates the above objections and concludes the correct recommendation is major revision, not accept.
activation_condition: Activated whenever any recommendation-changing challenge above remains unresolved.
defeat_condition: Defeated only when every recommendation-changing challenge is resolved and an accept-level recommendation is warranted.
resolution_summary: Unresolved: active major-revision condition remains; an accept-level integrated recommendation is not warranted, which blocks GC_sub and yields a bounded (UB) result.
